plain: The grandson of a man named Marone, whom the story ties to an event in Italy in 1933, "might be on the verge of saying something," and an Italian UFO researcher named Penotti is "really on that trail." This comes from UAPGerb, an online UFO researcher, who tells Michels it as something he has heard, without naming a source. If the grandson spoke, it could bring out new family testimony about that old Italian case.
